description: This shell script automates performance testing of Git repository pack reuse strategies. It sets up repositories with different pack configurations, manipulates pack files, and measures performance and size metrics for various reuse scenarios.

methods.name: find_pack
methods.description: Searches for a pack index file containing a specific object and returns the filename if found.

methods.name: repack_into_n_chunks
methods.description: Rearranges Git pack files into a specified number of chunks, performing packing, repacking, and cleanup operations.
